name: four-salt-float32-diversity
classification: pre-registered new collection, not a reconstruction of submission 915662

amendment.reason: Add a decoded old-member control through the mixed candidate's float64 arithmetic path, distinct from the already scored native old anchor; compare the candidate against this matched control. No result has been measured or model fitted under this campaign.

purpose: Measure whether four additional split-salt MLP/sequence pairs improve the existing float32 ensemble on one common unseen 70-shot tail.

fit.frames: All frames of every selected shot
fit.stopping: Ordinary validation-selected checkpoints; all hyperparameters except split.salt and split.holdout_share=0.01 are unchanged from the accepted YAML.
fit.guard: Rebuild and hash every salt-specific filename role list from the complete pinned 7,041-shot corpus before fitting; reject changed corpus, overlap with the original salt-0 70, changed model config, count mismatch or source mismatch.
fit.cache: Verify producer, dependency and input hashes; prepare all 6,971 allowed full-shot auxiliary blocks once, then atomically compose salt-specific train and validation caches from exact blocks. Never alias an old cache key.

evaluation.score_files: The 70 names in manifest.score_files, in that exact salt-0 order; no member may have them in train_files or val_files.
evaluation.source_predictions: Each artifact predicts mlp and seq separately through its own verified frozen source; decode maps and submitted scalars before any mixing.
evaluation.matched_decoded_old_control: Rebuild old eleven decoded maps from the six pinned source NPZs at weights 5:1:1:1:2:1, divide by 11 and cast once from float64 to float32. Pass the prior-eight scalar block through the same float64-to-float32 output path. Score this row separately from the saved old native anchor and report maximum per-field array difference and every native-term difference.
evaluation.new_block: Eight new decoded member predictions, equal weight 1/8 for psirz, q95 and betaN.
evaluation.mixed_candidate: For psirz, combine the six pre-existing decoded map sources at weights 5:1:1:1:2:1 divided by 22 and each new member at weight 1/16; for q95 and betaN, use one half of the existing prior-eight scalar block and one sixteenth of each new member. Accumulate in float64 and cast each output array exactly once to float32.
evaluation.native_scorer: Pin the scorer from runs/geometry-loss-screen-4a5516b9b1684353/source and score the saved old native anchor, the matched decoded old control, all eight individual members, the new-eight block and the one fixed mixed candidate on the same exact 70 filenames: twelve rows total. Preserve native JSON and all seven functional terms and failure counts.
evaluation.no_search: No weights, members, hyperparameters or scored files will be selected using these reused 70 shots.

investment_gate.effect: Only if the fixed candidate meets both criteria, review a separately validated full public float32 prediction and pointer; no Hugging Face mutation or submission is authorized by this screen.

interpretation: The original 70-shot tail has already informed earlier ensemble selection, so its paired differences are diagnostic and do not establish independent or public-fold improvement. The historical six-salt submission has unavailable fitted members and weights.

cost_estimate.one_time_allowed_auxiliary_cache_minutes: Approximately 18-20, subject to producer identity and host load
cost_estimate.total_wall_hours: Approximately 2-2.5 with one GPU lane, warm shot cache and no failures; estimate, not a measured duration
